s: 我们明天乘火车去上海。
s_py: wǒ men míng tiān chéng huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
zh: 我们明天乘火车去上海。
py: wǒ men míng tiān chéng huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
en: We are taking the train to Shanghai tomorrow.
why: 乘 is a slightly formal 坐 and is correct with 火车, 飞机 and 地铁 as a passenger.

q: 草原上，孩子们___着马慢慢地走。
zh: 草原上，孩子们骑着马慢慢地走。
py: cǎo yuán shang hái zi men qí zhe mǎ màn màn de zǒu
en: On the grassland the children ride slowly along on horses.
why: You sit astride a horse, so 骑马. 坐马 is not said, and 开马 is wrong because 开 is for vehicles.

q: 同事过生日，我想___他一份礼物。
zh: 同事过生日，我想送他一份礼物。
py: tóng shì guò shēng rì wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yī fèn lǐ wù
en: It's my colleague's birthday and I want to give him a present.
why: A present is given with 送, and 送他一份礼物 takes the person directly. 寄 needs 给 and the post, and 发 is for electronic things and handed-out wages.

q: 我家的猫昨天晚上___了四只小猫。
zh: 我家的猫昨天晚上生了四只小猫。
py: wǒ jiā de māo zuó tiān wǎn shang shēng le sì zhī xiǎo māo
en: Our cat had four kittens last night.
why: Giving birth is 生, also for animals: 生孩子, 生小猫. 起 and 留 do not mean giving birth.

q: 小朋友，___马路的时候要看红绿灯。
zh: 小朋友，过马路的时候要看红绿灯。
py: xiǎo péng yǒu guò mǎ lù de shí hou yào kàn hóng lǜ dēng
en: Children, look at the traffic lights when you cross the road.
why: Crossing a road is 过马路. 上马路 and 下马路 would suggest getting onto or off the road.

q: 明天要早起，我六点就得___床。
zh: 明天要早起，我六点就得起床。
py: míng tiān yào zǎo qǐ wǒ liù diǎn jiù děi qǐ chuáng
en: I have to get up early tomorrow, at six o'clock.
why: Getting up in the morning is 起床. 取 is 'collect', and 站床 is wrong because 站起来 means stand up from somewhere.

s: 爸爸今天系了一条蓝色的领带。
s_py: bà ba jīn tiān jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
zh: 爸爸今天系了一条蓝色的领带。
py: bà ba jīn tiān jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
en: Dad is wearing a blue tie today.
why: A tie is tied, so 系 (read jì) is the standard verb; 打领带 and 戴领带 are also heard, but 穿领带 is not.

q: 这条蓝裙子颜色很___，几乎是黑色的。
zh: 这条蓝裙子颜色很深，几乎是黑色的。
py: zhè tiáo lán qún zi yán sè hěn shēn jī hū shì hēi sè de
en: This blue skirt is such a dark colour that it is almost black.
why: Almost black means a dark shade, which is 深. 浅 is for light shades.

q: 我去银行___了一点儿钱，晚上请你吃饭。
zh: 我去银行取了一点儿钱，晚上请你吃饭。
py: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ le yī diǎn r qián wǎn shang qǐng nǐ chī fàn
en: I went to the bank to withdraw a little money; I'll treat you to dinner tonight.
why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 起钱 is a sound-alike error, and 生钱 means 'make money breed', not withdraw.

q: 我在手机上___了一辆车，司机五分钟就到。
zh: 我在手机上打了一辆车，司机五分钟就到。
py: wǒ zài shǒu jī shàng dǎ le yī liàng chē sī jī wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào
en: I ordered a car on my phone and the driver will be here in five minutes.
why: Calling or ordering a taxi is 打车. 坐 is to ride as a passenger and 开 is to drive, and neither fits a car that you order on the phone while the driver is still on the way.

s: 天太冷了，他戴了一件很厚的外套。
s_py: tiān tài lěng le tā dài le yī jiàn hěn hòu de wài tào
zh: 天太冷了，他穿了一件很厚的外套。
py: tiān tài lěng le tā chuān le yī jiàn hěn hòu de wài tào
en: It was so cold that he put on a thick coat.
why: A coat is clothing you get into, so 穿. 戴 is for accessories and is never used with 衣服 or 外套.

q: 你到家以后，请给我___个电话。
zh: 你到家以后，请给我打个电话。
py: nǐ dào jiā yǐ hòu qǐng gěi wǒ dǎ gè diàn huà
en: Please give me a call when you get home.
why: A phone call is 打电话, with the person marked by 给 before the verb. 做 and 说 are English 'make' and 'say' carried over; 做电话 and 说电话 do not exist.

s: 外面正在雪，你多穿点儿衣服。
s_py: wài miàn zhèng zài xuě nǐ duō chuān diǎn r yī fu
zh: 外面正在下雪，你多穿点儿衣服。
py: wài miàn zhèng zài xià xuě nǐ duō chuān diǎn r yī fu
en: It's snowing outside, so put on more clothes.
why: 雪 is a noun, so it needs the verb 下: 下雪. 正在雪 has no verb.

q: 我们站在桥上，请你给我们___张照片吧。
zh: 我们站在桥上，请你给我们拍张照片吧。
py: wǒ men zhàn zài qiáo shang qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ men pāi zhāng zhào piàn ba
en: We're standing on the bridge; please take a photo of us.
why: Taking a photo is 拍照片. 拿 means to pick up something that already exists, so 拿张照片 would be fetching a printed photo.

q: 我家离公司很远，每天___地铁要一个小时。
zh: 我家离公司很远，每天坐地铁要一个小时。
py: wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn yuǎn měi tiān zuò dì tiě yào yī gè xiǎo shí
en: My home is far from the office; the subway takes an hour every day.
why: You sit in the subway as a passenger, so 坐. 骑 is only for bikes and horses, and 开 would make you the driver.

q: 我还没___完今天的作业，不能出去玩。
zh: 我还没做完今天的作业，不能出去玩。
py: wǒ hái méi zuò wán jīn tiān de zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
en: I haven't finished today's homework, so I can't go out to play.
why: Homework is 做作业. 办作业 is wrong because 办 is for formalities and errands, not for schoolwork.

q: 我哥哥刚拿到驾照，今天第一次___汽车送我去上班。
zh: 我哥哥刚拿到驾照，今天第一次开汽车送我去上班。
py: wǒ gē ge gāng ná dào jià zhào jīn tiān dì yī cì kāi qì chē sòng wǒ qù shàng bān
en: My brother has just got his driving licence, and today he drove me to work for the first time.
why: The driver 开 the car. 坐 is for the passenger and 骑 is for things you sit astride, so neither works for 汽车 with a driver.

s: 我爸爸为了健康，已经不喝烟了。
s_py: wǒ bà ba wèi le jiàn kāng yǐ jīng bù hē yān le
zh: 我爸爸为了健康，已经不抽烟了。
py: wǒ bà ba wèi le jiàn kāng yǐ jīng bù chōu yān le
en: For the sake of his health my dad has already stopped smoking.
why: Cigarettes are 抽烟. 喝 is only for liquids, so 喝烟 is wrong.

q: 下个月是我妈妈的生日，我们打算在家___生日。
zh: 下个月是我妈妈的生日，我们打算在家过生日。
py: xià gè yuè shì wǒ mā ma de shēng rì wǒ men dǎ suàn zài jiā guò shēng rì
en: Next month is my mum's birthday and we plan to celebrate it at home.
why: Celebrating a birthday is 过生日 ('pass' it). 开 and 打 do not take 生日 as an object.

s: 我每天晚上睡觉以前都要洗牙。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang shuì jiào yǐ qián dōu yào xǐ yá
zh: 我每天晚上睡觉以前都要刷牙。
py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang shuì jiào yǐ qián dōu yào shuā yá
en: Every night before I go to bed I brush my teeth.
why: Daily tooth care is 刷牙. 洗牙 means a scale-and-polish at the dentist, which nobody does every night.

q: 昨天太累了，我晚上___了一个很长的梦。
zh: 昨天太累了，我晚上做了一个很长的梦。
py: zuó tiān tài lèi le wǒ wǎn shang zuò le yī gè hěn cháng de mèng
en: I was so tired yesterday that I had a very long dream in the night.
why: Chinese 'makes' a dream: 做梦. 有了一个梦 is the English 'have' carried over; 有梦想 'have a dream (ambition)' is a different thing.

q: 周末我们去公园___足球，小狗也跟着跑来跑去。
zh: 周末我们去公园踢足球，小狗也跟着跑来跑去。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán tī zú qiú xiǎo gǒu yě gēn zhe pǎo lái pǎo qù
en: At the weekend we go to the park to play football, and the dog runs around with us.
why: Football is kicked, so 踢足球. 打 is for basketball, tennis and other games played with hands or a racket; 弹 is for piano and guitar.

q: 这个问题很复杂，我花了一个晚上才___清楚。
zh: 这个问题很复杂，我花了一个晚上才搞清楚。
py: zhè ge wèn tí hěn fù zá wǒ huā le yī gè wǎn shang cái gǎo qīng chu
en: This problem is complicated; it took me a whole evening to figure it out.
why: Casual spoken 搞 + result (搞清楚 'work out, sort out') is the set phrase. 办清楚 would be about handling a procedure, and 打清楚 does not exist.

q: 医生说我的身体不好，不能再___烟了。
zh: 医生说我的身体不好，不能再抽烟了。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ de shēn tǐ bù hǎo bù néng zài chōu yān le
en: The doctor says my health is poor and I must not smoke any more.
why: Cigarettes are 抽烟. 喝烟 and 吃烟 are English-style errors; 喝 is for drinks and 吃 is for food.

q: 开车的时候一定要___好安全带。
zh: 开车的时候一定要系好安全带。
py: kāi chē de shí hou yī dìng yào jì hǎo ān quán dài
en: You must fasten your seat belt when driving.
why: A seat belt is fastened, so it takes 系 (read jì). 戴 and 穿 are for things you put on the body.

q: 小王的爸爸在上海___生意，常常出差。
zh: 小王的爸爸在上海做生意，常常出差。
py: xiǎo wáng de bà ba zài shàng hǎi zuò shēng yi cháng cháng chū chāi
en: Xiao Wang's father does business in Shanghai and often travels on business.
why: Doing business is 做生意. 办 is for formalities and errands, and 打 does not combine with 生意.

s: 我姐姐从小就弹小提琴，现在已经是老师了。
s_py: wǒ jiě jie cóng xiǎo jiù tán xiǎo tí qín xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì lǎo shī le
zh: 我姐姐从小就拉小提琴，现在已经是老师了。
py: wǒ jiě jie cóng xiǎo jiù lā xiǎo tí qín xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì lǎo shī le
en: My older sister has played the violin since she was little, and now she is a teacher.
why: The violin is bowed, so it is 拉小提琴. 弹 is for keys and plucked strings such as piano and guitar.

s: 我妹妹还不会开自行车。
s_py: wǒ mèi mei hái bù huì kāi zì xíng chē
zh: 我妹妹还不会骑自行车。
py: wǒ mèi mei hái bù huì qí zì xíng chē
en: My younger sister can't ride a bike yet.
why: You sit astride a bike, so 骑自行车. 开 is for cars, buses and trains that you drive.

q: 他手上___着一块很贵的手表。
zh: 他手上戴着一块很贵的手表。
py: tā shǒu shang dài zhe yī kuài hěn guì de shǒu biǎo
en: He is wearing a very expensive watch.
why: A watch is worn on the wrist with 戴. 穿手表 is the English-style error.

q: 在北京的那一年，给我留下了很___的印象。
zh: 在北京的那一年，给我留下了很深的印象。
py: zài běi jīng de nà yī nián gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng
en: That year in Beijing made a deep impression on me.
why: An impression is deep: 深印象. 重 is for illness and weight, and 浅 would mean a faint, superficial impression, which the positive 留下 does not suit.

q: 我要去邮局给奶奶___一个包裹。
zh: 我要去邮局给奶奶寄一个包裹。
py: wǒ yào qù yóu jú gěi nǎi nai jì yī gè bāo guǒ
en: I'm going to the post office to send a parcel to my grandma.
why: A parcel that goes through the post is 寄. 吃 is for eating and 坐 is for riding as a passenger, so neither can send a parcel.

q: 电脑突然坏了，这个问题你能不能___？
zh: 电脑突然坏了，这个问题你能不能解决？
py: diàn nǎo tū rán huài le zhè ge wèn tí nǐ néng bu néng jiě jué
en: The computer suddenly broke; can you solve this problem?
why: A broken computer is a problem to fix, so 解决. 回答 is only for a question that someone asks.

s: 他喜欢在手机上读电视剧。
s_py: tā xǐ huan zài shǒu jī shang dú diàn shì jù
zh: 他喜欢在手机上看电视剧。
py: tā xǐ huan zài shǒu jī shang kàn diàn shì jù
en: He likes watching TV series on his phone.
why: TV series are watched, so 看电视剧. 读 is for reading words, never for watching.

q: 他___决心每天跑步一个小时，因为医生说他太胖了。
zh: 他下决心每天跑步一个小时，因为医生说他太胖了。
py: tā xià jué xīn měi tiān pǎo bù yī gè xiǎo shí yīn wèi yī shēng shuō tā tài pàng le
en: He made up his mind to run for an hour every day, because the doctor said he was too fat.
why: Making up your mind is 下决心. 做 appears in 做决定 'make a decision', but 做决心 is not said.

s: 她给孩子取了一个好听的名字。
s_py: tā gěi hái zi qǔ le yī gè hǎo tīng de míng zi
zh: 她给孩子取了一个好听的名字。
py: tā gěi hái zi qǔ le yī gè hǎo tīng de míng zi
en: She gave the child a nice name.
why: 取名字 and 起名字 are both correct for giving a name, so 取 is fine here even though 取 usually means 'collect'.

q: 这部电影是一位有名的导演___的，很多人都去看了。
zh: 这部电影是一位有名的导演拍的，很多人都去看了。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng shì yī wèi yǒu míng de dǎo yǎn pāi de hěn duō rén dōu qù kàn le
en: This film was shot by a famous director, and many people went to see it.
why: Films are shot with 拍: 拍电影. 照 is for photographs only (照相), and 拿 means to pick something up.

q: 这个月公司十号才给我们___工资。
zh: 这个月公司十号才给我们发工资。
py: zhè ge yuè gōng sī shí hào cái gěi wǒ men fā gōng zī
en: This month the company did not pay us until the tenth.
why: Paying wages is 发工资. 送 is for giving presents and deliveries, and 吃 is for eating.

q: 外面风很___，你把窗户关上吧。
zh: 外面风很大，你把窗户关上吧。
py: wài miàn fēng hěn dà nǐ bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng ba
en: The wind is strong outside; close the window.
why: Wind is 大 or 小. 重 is for weight, and 风很高 is not said.

q: 天气预报说明天会___雪，你要多穿点儿衣服。
zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪，你要多穿点儿衣服。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià xuě nǐ yào duō chuān diǎn r yī fu
en: The weather forecast says it will snow tomorrow, so wear more clothes.
why: Snow falls, so 下雪, with no 'it' and no 是. 发 and 开 do not combine with 雪.

q: 天黑了，请___一下灯。
zh: 天黑了，请开一下灯。
py: tiān hēi le qǐng kāi yī xià dēng
en: It's dark; please turn on the light.
why: Lights are switched on with 开, and 关 switches them off. 站 and 坐 are body-position verbs and do not fit 灯.

s: 夏天太阳很大，她出门总是穿太阳镜。
s_py: xià tiān tài yáng hěn dà tā chū mén zǒng shì chuān tài yáng jìng
zh: 夏天太阳很大，她出门总是戴太阳镜。
py: xià tiān tài yáng hěn dà tā chū mén zǒng shì dài tài yáng jìng
en: The sun is strong in summer, so she always wears sunglasses when she goes out.
why: Sunglasses are glasses, so they take 戴. 穿 is only for clothes and shoes.

s: 昨天晚上我看手机看得太晚，今天很难取床。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ kàn shǒu jī kàn de tài wǎn jīn tiān hěn nán qǔ chuáng
zh: 昨天晚上我看手机看得太晚，今天很难起床。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ kàn shǒu jī kàn de tài wǎn jīn tiān hěn nán qǐ chuáng
en: I stayed up late on my phone last night, so it is hard to get up today.
why: Getting out of bed is 起床. 取 is 'collect or withdraw', so 取床 is a sound-alike error.

s: 公司明天上午要做会，大家别迟到。
s_py: gōng sī míng tiān shàng wǔ yào zuò huì dà jiā bié chí dào
zh: 公司明天上午要开会，大家别迟到。
py: gōng sī míng tiān shàng wǔ yào kāi huì dà jiā bié chí dào
en: The company has a meeting tomorrow morning, so don't be late.
why: A meeting is 开会. 做 is 'make' or 'do' and cannot be used for meetings.

q: 你哥哥___完大学以后做什么工作？
zh: 你哥哥上完大学以后做什么工作？
py: nǐ gē ge shàng wán dà xué yǐ hòu zuò shén me gōng zuò
en: What work will your brother do after he finishes university?
why: University is attended with 上 (上大学), and 上完 is 'finished attending'. 下大学 does not exist; finishing is 毕业.

q: 听说___飞机从上海到北京只要两个小时。
zh: 听说坐飞机从上海到北京只要两个小时。
py: tīng shuō zuò fēi jī cóng shàng hǎi dào běi jīng zhǐ yào liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: I hear it takes only two hours to fly from Shanghai to Beijing.
why: A passenger 坐飞机. 开飞机 means to pilot a plane, and 骑 is for bikes and horses.

q: 医院里的医生都___着口罩。
zh: 医院里的医生都戴着口罩。
py: yī yuàn lǐ de yī shēng dōu dài zhe kǒu zhào
en: The doctors in the hospital all wear masks.
why: A mask is worn with 戴. 穿口罩 is a classic error from English 'wear'; 穿 is for clothes, not for accessories.

q: 老板刚才给大家___了一封邮件，说明天不上班。
zh: 老板刚才给大家发了一封邮件，说明天不上班。
py: lǎo bǎn gāng cái gěi dà jiā fā le yī fēng yóu jiàn shuō míng tiān bù shàng bān
en: The boss just sent everyone an email saying there is no work tomorrow.
why: An email is sent with 发. 提 and 问 are for raising questions and do not fit 邮件.

q: 我哥哥每个星期六都___篮球。
zh: 我哥哥每个星期六都打篮球。
py: wǒ gē ge měi gè xīng qī liù dōu dǎ lán qiú
en: My older brother plays basketball every Saturday.
why: Basketball is a hand ball game and takes 打. 踢篮球 would mean kicking a basketball, and 弹 is for keyboard and plucked instruments.

q: 老师说今天的课就到这儿，现在___课。
zh: 老师说今天的课就到这儿，现在下课。
py: lǎo shī shuō jīn tiān de kè jiù dào zhè r xiàn zài xià kè
en: The teacher says that is all for today's lesson: class is over.
why: Class ends with 下课. 上课 would mean class begins, which contradicts 今天的课就到这儿.

q: 老师今天没有___作业，所以晚上我们可以出去玩。
zh: 老师今天没有留作业，所以晚上我们可以出去玩。
py: lǎo shī jīn tiān méi yǒu liú zuò yè suǒ yǐ wǎn shang wǒ men kě yǐ chū qù wán
en: The teacher didn't set any homework today, so we can go out tonight.
why: A teacher sets homework with 留作业 ('leaves' it). 生 and 取 are not used for homework.

q: 我下班回家以后先___饭，然后看电视。
zh: 我下班回家以后先做饭，然后看电视。
py: wǒ xià bān huí jiā yǐ hòu xiān zuò fàn rán hòu kàn diàn shì
en: After work I get home and cook first, then watch TV.
why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands (办手续, 办事), and 洗 is for washing (洗菜, 洗碗), not for making the meal.

s: 我妹妹明年上大学。
s_py: wǒ mèi mei míng nián shàng dà xué
zh: 我妹妹明年上大学。
py: wǒ mèi mei míng nián shàng dà xué
en: My younger sister starts university next year.
why: 上大学 means to go to university; 上 is the verb for attending school at any level.

q: 我每天睡觉以前都要___网看一会儿新闻。
zh: 我每天睡觉以前都要上网看一会儿新闻。
py: wǒ měi tiān shuì jiào yǐ qián dōu yào shàng wǎng kàn yī huì r xīn wén
en: Every day before I go to sleep I go online for a while to read the news.
why: Going online is 上网. 下网 does not exist (you 下线 or 关机 instead), and 开网 is not said.

s: 冬天骑自行车的时候要戴手套。
s_py: dōng tiān qí zì xíng chē de shí hou yào dài shǒu tào
zh: 冬天骑自行车的时候要戴手套。
py: dōng tiān qí zì xíng chē de shí hou yào dài shǒu tào
en: You should wear gloves when you ride a bike in winter.
why: Gloves are 戴. The sentence also shows 骑 for a bike, so there are two correct collocations in a row.

q: 小猫受了伤，伤得很___，要马上送去医院。
zh: 小猫受了伤，伤得很重，要马上送去医院。
py: xiǎo māo shòu le shāng shāng de hěn zhòng yào mǎ shàng sòng qù yī yuàn
en: The kitten is badly hurt and has to be taken to the vet straight away.
why: A serious injury is 重 (伤得很重); the opposite is 轻. 大 and 多 describe size and number, not severity.

q: 我不喜欢___电视，喜欢听音乐。
zh: 我不喜欢看电视，喜欢听音乐。
py: wǒ bù xǐ huan kàn diàn shì xǐ huan tīng yīn yuè
en: I don't like watching television; I like listening to music.
why: Television is watched, so 看电视. 读 and 念 are for reading words aloud or studying; 读电视 is not Chinese.

q: 我发烧了，下午要去医院___病。
zh: 我发烧了，下午要去医院看病。
py: wǒ fā shāo le xià wǔ yào qù yī yuàn kàn bìng
en: I have a fever and will go to the hospital this afternoon to see a doctor.
why: Going to the doctor is 看病. 读病 and 吃病 do not exist; 看 covers seeing a doctor, not just looking.

q: 同事们对新的上班时间___了一些意见。
zh: 同事们对新的上班时间提了一些意见。
py: tóng shì men duì xīn de shàng bān shí jiān tí le yī xiē yì jiàn
en: The colleagues made some comments about the new working hours.
why: Making a comment or suggestion is 提意见. 做意见 does not exist, and 回答 is for answering a question.

s: 孩子昨天晚上发烧了，今天要去医院。
s_py: hái zi zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shāo le jīn tiān yào qù yī yuàn
zh: 孩子昨天晚上发烧了，今天要去医院。
py: hái zi zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shāo le jīn tiān yào qù yī yuàn
en: The child had a fever last night and has to go to the hospital today.
why: 发烧 is the fixed phrase for having a fever; 发 here means 'give off', not 'send'.

s: 这个周末我们打算去山里度假。
s_py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn qù shān lǐ dù jià
zh: 这个周末我们打算去山里度假。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn qù shān lǐ dù jià
en: This weekend we plan to go on holiday in the mountains.
why: 度假 is the verb for spending a holiday away. It takes no object here; the place goes before it with 去 or 在.

s: 奶奶身体不好，常常喝中药。
s_py: nǎi nai shēn tǐ bù hǎo cháng cháng hē zhōng yào
zh: 奶奶身体不好，常常喝中药。
py: nǎi nai shēn tǐ bù hǎo cháng cháng hē zhōng yào
en: Grandma is in poor health and often drinks traditional Chinese medicine.
why: Herbal medicine is boiled into a drink, so 喝中药 is correct, while pills are 吃药.

s: 妈妈正在厨房办饭。
s_py: mā ma zhèng zài chú fáng bàn fàn
zh: 妈妈正在厨房做饭。
py: mā ma zhèng zài chú fáng zuò fàn
en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
why: Cooking is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands, and 办饭 does not exist.

s: 老板喜欢跟员工开玩笑，所以大家都不怕他。
s_py: lǎo bǎn xǐ huan gēn yuán gōng kāi wán xiào suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu bù pà tā
zh: 老板喜欢跟员工开玩笑，所以大家都不怕他。
py: lǎo bǎn xǐ huan gēn yuán gōng kāi wán xiào suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu bù pà tā
en: The boss likes to joke with the staff, so nobody is afraid of him.
why: 开玩笑 means to kid or joke around, with 跟 + person before the verb. It is a fixed phrase and is correct here.

q: 我今天没时间___饭，只喝了一杯咖啡。
zh: 我今天没时间吃饭，只喝了一杯咖啡。
py: wǒ jīn tiān méi shí jiān chī fàn zhǐ hē le yī bēi kā fēi
en: I had no time to eat today and only drank a cup of coffee.
why: Meals are eaten: 吃饭. 喝饭 is wrong, and the contrast with 喝了一杯咖啡 shows that 喝 belongs to the drink, not to 饭.

q: 我每天早上起床以后先___牙，再吃早饭。
zh: 我每天早上起床以后先刷牙，再吃早饭。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān shuā yá zài chī zǎo fàn
en: Every morning after getting up I brush my teeth first and then eat breakfast.
why: Daily tooth-brushing is 刷牙. 洗牙 is a professional cleaning at the dentist, and 梳 is for hair.

q: 面试的时候，男生一般都要穿西装，还要___领带。
zh: 面试的时候，男生一般都要穿西装，还要系领带。
py: miàn shì de shí hou nán shēng yī bān dōu yào chuān xī zhuāng hái yào jì lǐng dài
en: At interviews men generally have to wear a suit and a tie.
why: The suit is 穿, but the tie is knotted, so 系 (jì). 穿领带 is wrong, even though the verb before it is 穿.

s: 请小声一点儿，宝宝在睡觉。
s_py: qǐng xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r bǎo bao zài shuì jiào
zh: 请小声一点儿，宝宝在睡觉。
py: qǐng xiǎo shēng yī diǎn r bǎo bao zài shuì jiào
en: Please be a bit quieter; the baby is sleeping.
why: Speaking quietly is 小声, the opposite of 大声. It is a fixed adverb phrase and is correct.

q: 这种药饭后___，一天两次，一次一片。
zh: 这种药饭后吃，一天两次，一次一片。
py: zhè zhǒng yào fàn hòu chī yī tiān liǎng cì yī cì yī piàn
en: Take this medicine after meals, twice a day, one tablet each time.
why: Pills are eaten, so 吃药. 抽 is for cigarettes, and 看 is for reading, watching and seeing a doctor.

q: 冬天很冷，我给小狗___了一件红色的小衣服。
zh: 冬天很冷，我给小狗穿了一件红色的小衣服。
py: dōng tiān hěn lěng wǒ gěi xiǎo gǒu chuān le yī jiàn hóng sè de xiǎo yī fu
en: It is cold in winter, so I put a little red coat on the dog.
why: Clothes are 穿, also on a dog. 戴 is for accessories such as hats and glasses.

q: 他想学___小提琴，所以买了一把新琴。
zh: 他想学拉小提琴，所以买了一把新琴。
py: tā xiǎng xué lā xiǎo tí qín suǒ yǐ mǎi le yī bǎ xīn qín
en: He wants to learn the violin, so he bought a new instrument.
why: The violin is bowed, so it takes 拉. 弹 is for piano and guitar, and 吹 is for wind instruments such as the flute.

q: 这杯茶太___了，一点儿茶味也没有。
zh: 这杯茶太淡了，一点儿茶味也没有。
py: zhè bēi chá tài dàn le yī diǎn r chá wèi yě méi yǒu
en: This tea is too weak; it has no tea flavour at all.
why: Weak tea is 淡, the opposite of 浓. 浅 is for colour depth and water depth, and 轻 is for weight or light illness.

s: 这杯咖啡太强了，我晚上喝了就睡不着。
s_py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài qiáng le wǒ wǎn shang hē le jiù shuì bù zháo
zh: 这杯咖啡太浓了，我晚上喝了就睡不着。
py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài nóng le wǒ wǎn shang hē le jiù shuì bù zháo
en: This coffee is too strong; if I drink it in the evening I can't sleep.
why: Strong coffee is 浓. 强 describes people or things that are powerful, never the strength of a drink.

s: 外面下着很重的雨，你带伞了吗？
s_py: wài miàn xià zhe hěn zhòng de yǔ nǐ dài sǎn le ma
zh: 外面下着很大的雨，你带伞了吗？
py: wài miàn xià zhe hěn dà de yǔ nǐ dài sǎn le ma
en: It's raining hard outside; did you bring an umbrella?
why: Heavy rain is 大雨. 重 is for weight, serious illness or injury, and 重雨 is the English 'heavy' carried over.

q: 过年的时候，爸爸妈妈带我们去海边___假。
zh: 过年的时候，爸爸妈妈带我们去海边度假。
py: guò nián de shí hou bà ba mā ma dài wǒ men qù hǎi biān dù jià
en: At the New Year our parents take us on holiday to the seaside.
why: Taking a holiday is 度假. 过假 and 开假 are not said, although 过 is right for 过年 earlier in the sentence.

q: 下午两点公司要___会，请大家准时参加。
zh: 下午两点公司要开会，请大家准时参加。
py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn gōng sī yào kāi huì qǐng dà jiā zhǔn shí cān jiā
en: The company is holding a meeting at two this afternoon; please be on time.
why: A meeting is 开会. 做会 and 打会 do not exist; English 'hold a meeting' maps to 开.

q: 你的鞋带开了，快___一下吧。
zh: 你的鞋带开了，快系一下吧。
py: nǐ de xié dài kāi le kuài jì yī xià ba
en: Your shoelace has come undone; tie it quickly.
why: Shoelaces are tied with 系 (jì). 穿 is for putting on the shoes themselves, not for tying the laces.

s: 你对这个计划有什么要求，可以马上提出来。
s_py: nǐ duì zhè ge jì huà yǒu shén me yāo qiú kě yǐ mǎ shàng tí chū lái
zh: 你对这个计划有什么要求，可以马上提出来。
py: nǐ duì zhè ge jì huà yǒu shén me yāo qiú kě yǐ mǎ shàng tí chū lái
en: If you have any requests about this plan, you can raise them right away.
why: Requests, questions and suggestions are raised with 提; 提出来 is the usual spoken form.

q: 我不习惯喝太___的咖啡，请多加一点儿水。
zh: 我不习惯喝太浓的咖啡，请多加一点儿水。
py: wǒ bù xí guàn hē tài nóng de kā fēi qǐng duō jiā yī diǎn r shuǐ
en: I'm not used to very strong coffee; please add a bit more water.
why: Strong coffee is 浓. 强 describes power, not taste, and 重 is for weight or serious illness.

s: 我下午要去银行办事，不能参加会议。
s_py: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yín háng bàn shì bù néng cān jiā huì yì
zh: 我下午要去银行办事，不能参加会议。
py: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yín háng bàn shì bù néng cān jiā huì yì
en: I have to go to the bank on business this afternoon, so I can't attend the meeting.
why: 办事 means to run an errand or take care of business, which is the meaning here. 办 is the verb for errands and formalities.

s: 我刚给你寄了一条微信，你看到了吗？
s_py: wǒ gāng gěi nǐ jì le yī tiáo wēi xìn nǐ kàn dào le ma
zh: 我刚给你发了一条微信，你看到了吗？
py: wǒ gāng gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo wēi xìn nǐ kàn dào le ma
en: I just sent you a WeChat message; have you seen it?
why: 寄 is only for things that physically go through the post. Anything electronic, including a WeChat message, is 发.

q: 我早上忘了穿外套，晚上就___病了。
zh: 我早上忘了穿外套，晚上就生病了。
py: wǒ zǎo shang wàng le chuān wài tào wǎn shang jiù shēng bìng le
en: I forgot my coat in the morning and fell ill in the evening.
why: Falling ill is 生病. 取 and 起 do not form a word with 病.

q: 你别信，他只是在跟你___玩笑。
zh: 你别信，他只是在跟你开玩笑。
py: nǐ bié xìn tā zhǐ shì zài gēn nǐ kāi wán xiào
en: Don't believe it, he is only kidding you.
why: Kidding someone is 开玩笑, with 跟 + person before it. 讲 and 说 go with 笑话 (tell a joke), not with 玩笑.

s: 我儿子喜欢踢篮球。
s_py: wǒ ér zi xǐ huan tī lán qiú
zh: 我儿子喜欢打篮球。
py: wǒ ér zi xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
en: My son likes playing basketball.
why: Basketball is played with the hands, so it is 打篮球. 踢 is for football; 踢篮球 would mean kicking a basketball around.

s: 你这么晚还在办公室干什么？
s_py: nǐ zhè me wǎn hái zài bàn gōng shì gàn shén me
zh: 你这么晚还在办公室干什么？
py: nǐ zhè me wǎn hái zài bàn gōng shì gàn shén me
en: What are you still doing in the office so late?
why: 干什么 is the spoken 'do what' and is as correct as 做什么. It is a trap only because learners expect 做 here.

q: 我们公司早上九点___班，下午六点下班。
zh: 我们公司早上九点上班，下午六点下班。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zǎo shang jiǔ diǎn shàng bān xià wǔ liù diǎn xià bān
en: Our company starts work at nine in the morning and finishes at six in the afternoon.
why: Starting work is 上班 and finishing is 下班; the morning start with 九点 rules out 下. 开班 means to open a class, not to go to work.

s: 爷爷喜欢在手机上下棋，一下就是一个小时。
s_py: yé ye xǐ huan zài shǒu jī shàng xià qí yī xià jiù shì yī gè xiǎo shí
zh: 爷爷喜欢在手机上下棋，一下就是一个小时。
py: yé ye xǐ huan zài shǒu jī shàng xià qí yī xià jiù shì yī gè xiǎo shí
en: Grandpa likes playing chess on his phone, and he plays for a whole hour at a time.
why: Chess takes 下 (put pieces down), so 下棋 is right even on a phone. The second 下 in 一下就是一个小时 is the same verb.

q: 她每天回家以后先___一会儿钢琴，再做作业。
zh: 她每天回家以后先弹一会儿钢琴，再做作业。
py: tā měi tiān huí jiā yǐ hòu xiān tán yī huì r gāng qín zài zuò zuò yè
en: After getting home every day she plays the piano for a while before doing her homework.
why: The piano is played with 弹 (press the keys). 拉 is for the violin and other bowed strings, and 打钢琴 is not said.

q: 房间里太热了，我们___空调吧。
zh: 房间里太热了，我们开空调吧。
py: fáng jiān lǐ tài rè le wǒ men kāi kōng tiáo ba
en: It is too hot in the room, so let's turn on the air conditioning.
why: Switching on the air conditioning is 开空调 (switch off is 关). 打 and 坐 do not combine with 空调.

q: 我现在在开会，不方便接电话，你给我___短信吧。
zh: 我现在在开会，不方便接电话，你给我发短信吧。
py: wǒ xiàn zài zài kāi huì bù fāng biàn jiē diàn huà nǐ gěi wǒ fā duǎn xìn ba
en: I'm in a meeting and can't take calls; send me a text message.
why: A text message is sent with 发. 寄 is only for things that go through the post, so 寄短信 is wrong.

q: 小王在咖啡店___工，一个星期去三天。
zh: 小王在咖啡店打工，一个星期去三天。
py: xiǎo wáng zài kā fēi diàn dǎ gōng yī gè xīng qī qù sān tiān
en: Xiao Wang works part-time in a café three days a week.
why: A part-time job is 打工. 拉 and 下 do not form a verb with 工 that means doing a part-time job.

q: 小狗身上很脏，今天要给它___澡。
zh: 小狗身上很脏，今天要给它洗澡。
py: xiǎo gǒu shēn shang hěn zāng jīn tiān yào gěi tā xǐ zǎo
en: The dog is dirty, so it needs a bath today.
why: Bathing is 洗澡. 刷 is for teeth and shoes, and 梳 is for combing hair.

q: 我想去国外工作，所以要先___签证。
zh: 我想去国外工作，所以要先办签证。
py: wǒ xiǎng qù guó wài gōng zuò suǒ yǐ yào xiān bàn qiān zhèng
en: I want to work abroad, so I first have to get a visa.
why: Official paperwork takes 办: 办签证, 办手续. 开 and 打 do not form a collocation with 签证.

q: 他眼睛不好，看书的时候要___眼镜。
zh: 他眼睛不好，看书的时候要戴眼镜。
py: tā yǎn jing bù hǎo kàn shū de shí hou yào dài yǎn jìng
en: His eyes are poor, so he has to wear glasses when he reads.
why: Glasses are worn with 戴. 穿 is only for things you get into, such as clothes and shoes, and 系 is for things you tie.

q: 老师问了一个很难的问题，大家都不会___。
zh: 老师问了一个很难的问题，大家都不会回答。
py: lǎo shī wèn le yī gè hěn nán de wèn tí dà jiā dōu bù huì huí dá
en: The teacher asked a very hard question and nobody could answer it.
why: The teacher asked, so the class has to 回答. 提 would be to raise a question, which is the teacher's part and has no object left here.

s: 护士给我打了一针。
s_py: hù shi gěi wǒ dǎ le yī zhēn
zh: 护士给我打了一针。
py: hù shi gěi wǒ dǎ le yī zhēn
en: The nurse gave me an injection.
why: 打针 is the normal phrase for giving or receiving an injection, and 给我打了一针 is right with the nurse as subject. 打 is not only for hitting.

q: 下雨了，出门记得___伞。
zh: 下雨了，出门记得打伞。
py: xià yǔ le chū mén jì de dǎ sǎn
en: It's raining, so remember to use an umbrella when you go out.
why: An umbrella is held up with 打 (打伞). 戴 is for hats and glasses and 穿 for clothes; neither works for an umbrella.

q: 快递到了，我下班路上去小区门口___包裹。
zh: 快递到了，我下班路上去小区门口取包裹。
py: kuài dì dào le wǒ xià bān lù shang qù xiǎo qū mén kǒu qǔ bāo guǒ
en: The delivery has arrived; I'll pick up the parcel at the gate of the housing estate on my way home.
why: Collecting something that is waiting for you is 取: 取包裹. 起 is for getting up and naming, and 生 is for birth and illness.

q: 他去银行___手续，排了一个多小时的队。
zh: 他去银行办手续，排了一个多小时的队。
py: tā qù yín háng bàn shǒu xù pái le yī gè duō xiǎo shí de duì
en: He went to the bank to take care of the formalities and queued for over an hour.
why: Formalities are handled with 办: 办手续. 开 and 打 do not collocate with 手续.

q: 这双运动鞋是新买的，我今天第一次___。
zh: 这双运动鞋是新买的，我今天第一次穿。
py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié shì xīn mǎi de wǒ jīn tiān dì yī cì chuān
en: I bought these sports shoes recently; today is the first time I'm wearing them.
why: Shoes are 穿. 戴 is for glasses, hats, watches and masks, never for footwear.

q: 老师让我们大声___课文，然后再回答问题。
zh: 老师让我们大声读课文，然后再回答问题。
py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men dà shēng dú kè wén rán hòu zài huí dá wèn tí
en: The teacher asked us to read the text aloud and then answer questions.
why: 读课文 is reading a text out loud, which 大声 makes clear. 看 is silent looking and cannot be done 大声.
